title: Messianic Prophecy Fulfillment
content: The Old Testament contains many prophecies about the coming Messiah, written centuries before the birth of Jesus Christ. Christians believe these prophecies were fulfilled in the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus. The prophet Micah foretold that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem. Isaiah described a suffering servant who would bear the sins of many. Psalm 22 describes details of crucifixion, including pierced hands and feet. Daniel 9 presents a prophetic timeline pointing to the coming of the Messiah. These fulfilled prophecies are considered powerful evidence supporting the identity of Jesus as the promised Messiah.
